The trace at line 1263 and after reads 'write move=edit value=1', then 'held tag=same hash=7bbf4ef4', then 'reply tag=same hash=7bbf4ef4', then 'release gate=true': write before held, and reply before release.
cost: A reader of the one ordering record the plan said could not be recovered later would conclude the duplicate was held after the save's write, the opposite of what the controlled scenario forces.
